# writeEditorProject()

> **writeEditorProject**(`project?`: `string`, `options?`: [`ProjectOptions`](../interfaces/ProjectOptions.md)): [`ProjectWorld`](../interfaces/ProjectWorld.md)

Defined in: [src/project/editor.ts:20](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/editor.ts#L20)

Refresh the declarations and tsconfig used by the author's TypeScript editor. Uses the same layer order as a build, including translations from source-package dependencies. Unchanged files keep their modification times.
